text:
maya: Quick Q — where's the start-to-end tracing view for streaming WS sessions? I want to link disconnects with partial-frames errors and kv-cache hits.

chen: Try the Grafana traces panel named `ws-session-traces` or Jaeger search: https://jaeger.redwood.local/search?service=runtime&span=ws_connect — filter by `trace.tag=session_id`.

lucas: For logs use Splunk: `index=runtime \"ws_disconnect\" AND session_id=<id>` then look for `partial_frame=true` in the event payload.

sophia: If you're after chunk timing percentiles by model, there's a dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/chunk-timing — I can add a link from the session traces panel so folks can jump straight to timing breakdown.

maya: Thanks. Also FYI alerts were noisy yesterday: ops-alerts fired twice for "partial frame rate > 1%" during a canary. Who owns tuning that alert?

ops-alerts: Alert #WS_PARTIAL_RATE triggered — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ws-partial. Consider switching to an adaptive threshold or adding suppressions for deploy labels.

chen: I'd propose adaptive: baseline = rolling 1h median, alert if rate > baseline + 2σ AND rate > 0.5% absolute. I can open a PR to change rule and add a deploy suppression.

lucas: +1. Also add a suppression window when `label=deploy=canary` so we don't get duplicate noise during rollouts.

sophia: I'll add Grafana annotations for deploy windows so humans can correlate spikes with deployments. Can someone drop the panel id we should annotate?

chen: Panel id for chunk timing is `panel=17` on that dashboard. Quick Prom query for partial frames per 100k tokens: `sum(rate(ws_partial_frames_total[5m])) / sum(rate(ws_tokens_served_total[5m])) * 1e5`.

maya: Perfect. I'll run a trace+log hunt for a session and post session_id here. @chen please open the PR for the adaptive rule + canary suppression.

chen: On it, will tag @sophia for dashboard annotation changes and @lucas for alert runbook updates.

runtime-bot: Deploy scheduled to prod in 23:00 UTC — expected canary period 15m :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

maya: Noted — will avoid heavy trace testing during that window.
